Subject: Draft Q3 board packet — OKR variances & action runbook

Team — attaching Q3_board_draft_v3.pptx and the OKR appendix tracker. Two quick framing notes before you open: 

1) We have three OKRs that are materially behind target (Customer Latency, Dedicated Revenue, Platform Reliability). I call out root causes on slide 6 but we need clear owner + mitigation steps for the packet.
2) The board will expect: current state, actions (30/60/90d), quantifiable impact, and the ask (budget/credits/priority).

Asks: 
- Please review slides 1–8 and the OKR appendix. Mark redline comments in the deck or add row-level notes in OKR_appendix_tracker.xlsx.
- I need a consolidated action runbook (CSV) with owners and ETA by Thu Aug 26 EOD so we can circulate to the board sec by Mon.

High level checklist: 
- [ ] Confirm owner for each remediation
- [ ] One-line expected impact per action
- [ ] Any finance/budget asks flagged separately

Attachments: Q3_board_draft_v3.pptx, OKR_appendix_tracker.xlsx

Thanks — short review window here. I will compile and produce a sign-off version on Aug 30.

— Neha Kapoor
VP, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft Q3 board packet — OKR variances & action runbook

Neha — reviewed quickly this morning. Good framing. A few inline notes: 

- Slide 3 (market context): tighten to two bullets; current wording reads like a product FAQ. The board wants impact, not features.
- Slide 6 (latency remediation): add a risk column (rollback window / customer impact) and a clear fallback model.
- OKR appendix: row for Dedicated Revenue needs a weekly cadence (owner: Marcus suggested) — I can own the cadence if Marcus is out.

I added comments in the deck and a short set of suggested language below you can paste into the slide: 
> Proposed 30d action: enable conservative batching policy for high-latency customers (owner: Platform Eng, expected 15–25% latency improvement, risk: none to correctness).

Timing: I can synthesize the action runbook into the CSV if you want—give me the owners list and I’ll fill in the ETA.

Jonas
Director, Product
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft Q3 board packet — OKR variances & action runbook

Thanks — I pushed a few line edits and added a finance tab (finance_variance_comments.xlsx). Two asks from my side: 

1) The revenue numbers on slide 9 do not match the forecast we shared with finance — please confirm whether the Dedicated pipeline number is ARR or TTM. Finance prefers ARR for the board package.
2) We should call out any potential credit/commit ask in a separate appendix so the board can see the ROI logic.

I also flagged a short appendix on risks related to Private deployment support costs. If we plan to request budget, we should include a simple cost/benefit. I linked a draft subset in the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ3_BoardPacket

Attached: finance_variance_comments.xlsx

—Laura
Head of Finance Operations

Cc: board@investorco.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 board packet — delivery window and compliance attachments?

Neha/Laura — quick note from the board office. Thank you for the heads up. Two items we need confirmed before the packet goes to the directors: 

1) Final slide deck by Tuesday Sep 1, COB PT. We will redistribute to the board with a short read memo.
2) Please include SOC 2 scope statement or a pointer to the compliance package (if hosted on your portal). If you anticipate redlines on the financials, flag those in the accompanying memo.

If you can confirm timelines and attach the compliance pointer, I’ll lock the distribution.

Best,
Samantha Lee

Highlights of changes
- Reduced market framing to two bullets per Samantha's ask.
- Added risk column to latency remediation (slide 6) and explicit rollback steps.
- Finance clarified: Dedicated number reported as ARR; Laura confirmed changes in finance_variance_comments.xlsx.
- Runbook (runbook_task_list.csv): owners and 30/60/90 ETAs populated. Key owners: Jonas (Platform cadence), Aditya (Dedicated revenue play), Marissa (CS comms).

Immediate asks (please reply-all with the single word APPROVE or a one-line change):
- APPROVE final deck & runbook for board distribution by Sep 1 COB PT
- If you do not APPROVE, provide one-line change and I will incorporate before Tue 10:00 PT

Attachment stubs: 
- Q3_board_draft_v4.pptx (finalized slide numbers and appendix)
- runbook_task_list.csv (columns: action, owner, ETA, impact_estimate, status)
- finance_variance_comments.xlsx (finance notes)

Compliance pointer: SOC 2 scope summary is at https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/infra/compliance/SOC2-summary.pdf (linked in related_links).

Thanks — I will lock and send to Samantha on Tue morning once we have approvals.
